records.title: Romanian Literature, Art, and Film: One Century of Cultural Transformations
records.header: ROMN 420 Romanian Literature, Art, and Film: One Century of Cultural Transformations (5) A&H/SSc
records.text: ROMN 420 Romanian Literature, Art, and Film: One Century of Cultural Transformations (5) A&H/SSc Explores Eastern and Western artistic trends and ideologies in Romanian literature and culture during the last 100 years. Investigates contributions to surrealism, dadaism, theatre of the absurd, and practices of resistance against communism as well as women's roles in forging a post-Soviet identity. Taught in English.
